lines: The wind that passed between us
brought loneliness from somewhere
After we cried, the sky
was oddly crystal‑clear
My father's words, usually sharp
felt warm today
Kindness, smiles, even the way dreams are spoken
I didn’t know any of them, so I copied you completely
Just a little longer, just a little more
Just a little longer, please
Just a little longer, just a little more
Shall we stay close a bit longer
We’re time‑flyers, climbers racing the hours
The hide‑and‑seek of time, I’m tired of being the stray one
Crying with joy, laughing with sorrow
Your heart has already outrun you
Even the toys I wished for up to the stars
now lie in the corner of the room
I’ve added a hundred wishes today
Let’s someday trade that one thing
The kid who never talks spoke to me today
after school, “see you tomorrow,” she said
It’s nice to try something unfamiliar now and then
Especially when you’re beside me
Just a little longer, just a little more
Just a little longer, please
Just a little longer, just a little more
Let’s stay close a bit longer
We’re time‑flyers, I knew you all along
Long before I even remembered my own name
Even a world without you must have some meaning
But a world without you feels like August without summer vacation
A world without you is like a Santa who never laughs
A world without you
We’re time‑flyers, climbers racing the hours
The hide‑and‑seek of time, I’m tired of being the stray one
It’s nothing, really, it’s nothing at all
I’m heading out right now
We’re time‑flyers, climbers racing the hours
The hide‑and‑seek of time, the stray one is enough now
You’re a flamboyant climber, I wish I could stop those tears
But you refused, and seeing the tears that kept flowing made me understand
Crying with joy, laughing with sorrow
My heart has already outrun me
